fusions.name: Prick, Then Away
fusions.desc: A quick jab deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after it.

fusions.name: Frozen Mid-Stride
fusions.desc: Throws a spike up to 6 tiles. It deals 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and stuns the target for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Brace and Bolt
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Blooded Points
fusions.desc: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
